name: adaptive-task-routing
description: Route complex work to an appropriate conversation context, model, and reasoning effort using shared runtime capability detection and independent user controls.

interface.shortDescription: Choose context, model, and reasoning for complex work.
interface.longDescription: Adaptive Task Routing helps with multi-step audits, scans, research, planning, coding, debugging, architecture, and validation. The AI first presents the requested findings or actionable plan, then adds a clearly separated recommendation for conversation context, model, and reasoning effort before the next substantial phase. Independent controls support ask, auto, and off modes, while capability checks allow verified automation or clear user actions.
defaultPrompt: Use adaptive task routing before the next substantial phase.
